title: measurementCondition
description: Operating point at which an output value was measured or computed. All fields optional; absence implies the conventional default for the family (e.g. small-signal at 0 A DC bias, ambient temperature). Promoted to EAS from the inline measurementCondition under MAS magnetizingInductance so any family's outputs can use it.

voltageRms.description: RMS test voltage applied across the component (small-signal characterisation). Unit: V.

currentRms.description: RMS test current through the component. Unit: A.

dcBias.description: DC bias at which the value was measured. For caps and inductors this is the DC voltage / current at the terminals; for semiconductors it is the steady-state operating point of the relevant electrode.

temperature.description: Temperature at which the value was measured. Unit: Celsius.
